startup_sequence: Read task-specific context with prepare_manager_context for non-trivial requests; use today_context for broad daily overview, and use memory_context_for when the task depends on owner preferences, writing style, prior lessons, Gmail context, CRM cleanup behavior, or repeated workflow decisions.

If the task involves local knowledge-base use, search, expansion, audit, or restructuring, use probe_knowledge_base first; open source_of_truth/open_first when has_knowledge=true; use compact annotations before broad source-pack reads; use sync_knowledge_base, audit_knowledge_base, and audit_knowledge_annotations if docs/catalogs/skills/annotations changed.
If the current task involves email, inspect Gmail inbox state and relevant threads.
If the user asks about live CRM state, call AutoStop CRM get_connector_identity, get_runtime_status, bootstrap_context, or get_board_context.

If the owner says 'Приберись', 'прибейсь', 'прибери доску', 'обслужи доску', 'актуализируй доску', or asks for routine board cleanup, inspect docs/agent/board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md and run the board-cleanup autopilot behavior without moving cards between columns.
If the owner provides new files or asks to expand the knowledge base, inspect docs/agent/knowledge_intake_playbook.md before storing anything in memory.

If the task involves ИП requisites, company-card data, AutoStop business identity, ИП Гришкявичус/Гришкевичус, or sorting old versus current owner business documents, inspect docs/agent/business_identity_playbook.md and use the private business_identity route.
If the task involves vehicle identification or VIN/chassis decoding, inspect docs/agent/vehicle_identity_playbook.md before parts search.
If the task involves original catalog numbers from VIN or chassis number, inspect docs/agent/vin_oem_lookup_playbook.md and docs/agent/vin_oem_sources.json before searching marketplaces.

If the task involves oils, operating fluids, fill capacities, or ТО planning, inspect docs/agent/fluid_maintenance_playbook.md and use recommend_fluid_maintenance_sources before giving capacity/spec facts.
If the task involves gearbox or transmission diagnosis, clutch adaptation, or transmission-fluid service, inspect docs/agent/transmission_playbook.md before giving any gearbox fact.

If the task involves Volkswagen Group DSG, Audi S tronic, DQ200, DQ250, DQ381, DQ500, DL501, DL382, mechatronic/J217/J743, ODIS/SVM software update, or DSG basic settings/adaptation, inspect docs/agent/dsg_transmission_playbook.md and docs/agent/automotive_sources/dsg_transmission_sources.json before giving software, adaptation, mechatronic, fluid, or parts-fitment facts.

If the task involves Toyota GR Yaris, Yaris GR, GXPA16, G16E-GTS, GR-FOUR, 6MT EA67F, 8AT UC80F, clutch, fluids, recalls, TSBs, or OEM parts, probe the knowledge base and inspect docs/agent/toyota_gr_yaris_playbook.md before giving repair, fluid, TSB, recall, or OEM part facts.

If the task involves general BMW repair, diagnostics, DTC/fault memory, body electronics, xDrive, ZF transmission, HV, or BMW fluids, probe the knowledge base, then inspect docs/agent/bmw_repair_playbook.md before broad BMW source search.

If the task involves repair diagnostics, TSBs, recalls, repair procedures, wiring, fluids, torque specs, labor, ADAS, SRS, HV, immobilizer, or programming, inspect docs/agent/automotive_repair_source_playbook.md and route through docs/agent/automotive_sources before giving technical facts.

If the task involves BMW X5 F15 xDrive50i, N63TU/N63T, BDC, F15 electrical/electronics, injector bulletins, misfires, oil consumption, or cooling, use docs/agent/bmw_repair_playbook.md and the indexed BMW repair source cache.

If the task involves Krasnoyarsk workshop management, procurement, staff load, customer flow, finance control, or daily CRM control, inspect docs/agent/krasnoyarsk_service_management_playbook.md and use recommend_service_management_actions.
Use focused CRM tools before heavy wall/snapshot exports.

After meaningful work, write manager_journal; when the important result is a reusable lesson from praise, criticism, clear success, clear failure, or an owner request to do something differently, use learn_from_feedback.

context_navigation.purpose: Combine command routes, relevant memory/rules, knowledge routing, missing required context, and next actions before acting.

run_ledger.rule: Record planned actions, skipped writes, risks, writes, and verification evidence; store only durable summaries in manager memory.

memory_quality.rule: Use audit_memory before memory cleanup or when recall quality is weak; use curate_memory only for non-destructive duplicate archiving and keep source records out of normal recall with archived_at rather than deleting them.

rules: Use probe_knowledge_base as the cheap first pass for vehicle, brand, system, fluid, diagnostic, parts, CRM, or local-knowledge questions.
Use compact annotations to identify the narrow file or skill before reading large source packs.
If probe_knowledge_base returns has_knowledge=true, open open_first/source_of_truth before broad file search.
Use search_knowledge_base only after probing, preferably constrained to the returned best_domain.
Run sync_knowledge_base after durable docs/catalog/skill changes.
Run audit_knowledge_base after source intake or route-card edits.
Run audit_knowledge_annotations after compact annotation edits.
Update both the Markdown index and JSON map when adding a durable playbook, source catalog, or model-specific skill.
Keep raw manuals, copied licensed data, CRM snapshots, and temporary search results out of durable memory.
Use dedicated Codex skills for substantial model-specific corpora.
private_business_identity: Search business_identity first for ИП, реквизиты, карточка предприятия, AutoStop business identity, or ИП Гришкявичус/Гришкевичус questions.
Use data/private_knowledge/business_identity_current.json for current facts and data/private_knowledge/business_documents_inventory.json for date-sorted source inventory.
Do not copy private bank/contact details into Git-tracked docs or public summaries.
Verify exact banking/legal wording against the original source document before external use.

vehicle_identity: Classify the raw identifier first: ISO VIN, Japanese chassis/frame number, or market-specific body/model code.
Use the market-appropriate path: official manufacturer pages, inspection-certificate lookups, recall portals, and EPC data when available.
Record the stable outputs only: market, model family, engine, transmission, plant or build window, and explicit uncertainty.
Hand off to parts_search only after the vehicle identity is stable.
vin_oem_lookup: Classify the identifier first and choose the source by market.
Use NHTSA vPIC first for ISO VINs.
Use manufacturer frame-number or EPC paths for Japan-market chassis numbers.
Prefer explicit OEM or supersession data over inferred trim guesses.
automotive_repair_sources: Collect VIN/chassis, year, make, model, trim, engine, transmission, market, mileage, complaint, and scan results before technical recommendations.
Use OEM service information first, then official recalls/government data, then licensed professional databases, then standards, then Bosch/Springer references, then internal confirmed cases.
Use recommend_automotive_sources or source-route to select sources by brand and data type.
Do not provide torque, fluids, pinouts, ADAS, SRS, HV, immobilizer, programming, labor, or original-price facts without source-backed verification.
bmw_repair: Use probe_knowledge_base before broad BMW file reads; when best_domain is bmw_repair, open docs/agent/bmw_repair_playbook.md first.
Use docs/agent/bmw_repair_playbook.md and docs/agent/automotive_sources/source_cache/bmw_repair_knowledge_pack/ as owner-provided route/index material.
Switch to the BMW F15/N63 route when model/engine/chassis matches.
Collect VIN/chassis, market, year/model/chassis code, engine code, transmission code, mileage, complaint, and BMW fault memory with module names.

Verify final repair procedures, wiring, torque, coding/programming, campaigns, and fluid capacities through BMW ISTA/AIR/ETK/AOS/TIS, official BMW owner/recall data, BMW/NHTSA SIBs, or ZF official data.
toyota_gr_yaris: Use probe_knowledge_base before general Toyota routing; when best_domain is toyota_gr_yaris, open docs/agent/toyota_gr_yaris_playbook.md first.
Confirm the vehicle is true GR Yaris GXPA16/G16E-GTS, not normal Yaris, Yaris Cross, or Yaris GR Sport.
Collect VIN or Japan frame number, market, production month, grade, transmission, LSD/front-rear diff package, sub-radiator, mileage, DTCs, and complaint.
Use Toyota-Tech Europe, Toyota TIS where market-covered, Toyota Manuals AU, Toyota owner manual pages, official recall portals, and dealer EPC before public catalog or forum clues.
Treat public EPC catalogs such as Nengun, Amayama, MegaZip, PartSouq, and 7zap as cross-checks until Toyota EPC/dealer confirms fitment by VIN/frame.
fluid_maintenance: Collect VIN/chassis, market, year, make, model, engine code, transmission code, drivetrain, exact unit, and service operation.
Use docs/agent/fluid_maintenance_playbook.md and recommend_fluid_maintenance_sources before giving oil, fluid, approval, or capacity facts.
Separate oil-only, oil-and-filter, drain/refill, dry fill, pan removal, cooler-line drain, and level-check temperature/procedure.
Use lubricant selectors only as product cross-check after OEM or licensed source verification.
parts_search: Normalize the part identity from the card or owner message: OEM number, model, year, side, axle, and condition.
Search Drom first with exact OEM, then exact OEM plus Красноярск, then model and description variants.
Search ZZap next for price comparison, seller coverage, and replacements; switch to Красноярск and use all/new/used modes plus 'все замены'.
Search Avito after ZZap with exact OEM and model, but treat it as a direct-site manual search because external snippets are not always reliable.
If exact hits are sparse, broaden to platform, generation, and functional description, then rank exact OEM, local sellers, and confirmed replacements highest.
service_management: Use recommend_service_management_actions to classify the management area before acting.
Read live board state from AutoStopCRM MCP; do not rely on copied counts or stale snapshots.
Treat technician columns as load signals and procurement columns as blocker queues.
For parts blockers, route through VIN/OEM, Drom, ZZap, Avito, Emex, Exist, Autodoc, and local Krasnoyarsk suppliers depending on urgency.
For staff decisions, compare CRM load, sold hours, blocked hours, rework notes, and current market salary/vacancy sources.
For finance decisions, read repair orders and cashboxes from CRM; store only follow-up decisions in memory.
board_cleanup_autopilot: Trigger on owner phrases: Приберись, прибейсь, прибери доску, обслужи доску, актуализируй доску, or routine board cleanup.
In hourly automation mode, treat cleanup as incremental: prioritize blockers, write only meaningful deltas, avoid duplicate AI notes, and skip writes when CRM/MCP health is uncertain.
Operate as full autopilot without column moves/archive: enrich VIN/OEM/parts/technical data, update cards, tags, deadlines, indicators, detailed descriptions, and the separate board_summary preview.
Do not move cards between columns during board-cleanup autopilot unless the owner gives a separate explicit move command.
Do not archive cards during board-cleanup autopilot unless the owner gives a separate explicit archive command; leave archive recommendations instead.
Preserve user data: never delete works, materials, prices, payments, cashbox records, files, contacts, VIN/chassis/license data, manual diagnostics, or historical notes.

When a VIN/chassis/frame number exists and engine_model, gearbox_model, or drivetrain is empty, enrich vehicle_profile only from source-backed data; preserve manual fields and leave uncertainty in oem_notes/tentative_fields.

After description, title, tags, or vehicle_profile changes, call set_card_board_summary and verify board_summary_stale=false; keep phone, VIN, full client identity, raw scan dumps, and long issue lists out of board_summary.
Keep card notes short; use concise AI: notes for questions, next actions, OEM/price/source conclusions, payment blockers, and stale-card questions.
Ask the owner in chat only for destructive actions beyond archive, unresolved money conflicts, client-sensitive decisions, or safety-critical technical uncertainty.
End with a brief report: checked, updated, archived, left in current columns by rule, VIN/OEM/parts work, unresolved blockers, and risks.

memory_navigation.before_answering_contextual_questions: use memory_context_for first, then recall or recall_lessons for more specific owner/client/rent/rule/email terms if not obvious from the current chat
memory_navigation.after_new_owner_instruction: remember durable facts that are not CRM records or raw email copies and record MCP surface changes that affect future work
memory_navigation.after_feedback_or_result_signal: use learn_from_feedback when praise, criticism, clear success, clear failure, or a request to do something differently creates a reusable lesson
memory_navigation.navigation_review: use memory_map, memory_topics, and memory_gaps to understand what the manager knows and where memory is weak
memory_navigation.after_file_intake: store only durable conclusions from the file, update the relevant playbook or catalog, and journal the change

workflow: extract durable conclusions and routing rules

common_service_signals: ready cars with unpaid due_total need attention
parts orders and supply columns often require follow-up
client linking should be checked before creating duplicate clients
manual vehicle/client fields are authoritative unless owner says otherwise
gmail threads often contain follow-up requests, approvals, and deadlines that should be turned into tasks or reminders
new CRM MCP commands should be reflected in the local catalog before future sessions depend on them
new manager MCP commands or knowledge-intake rules should be reflected in the local memory catalog before future sessions depend on them
Krasnoyarsk service-management work should be routed through the dedicated playbook and source catalog before ad hoc decisions

Routine board cleanup does not grant permission to move or archive cards; those require separate explicit owner commands
